data.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?

result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, I'd recommend **Linear** as the best project management tool overall, particularly if you're building a tech product or running a fast-moving team.

However, the best choice depends on your startup's stage, team size, and how you work. You don't want an overly complicated system that takes more time to manage than the actual work.

## Best project management tools for startups

![Fast growing startups are built on Linear](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/piHpddRS6n9dTggcCRU3QzspXui7xfTg4qksC0xamyVTz0l5rmZLEYCGsVB7KKUouzfiOTbe-9ydzUq7UB2MFrNbZIGlaUSNjP0C8Bhd2CXnbxL2xZ05zw3USDTcATN8Ed4Fr3ygsGaA-sAB5VFRUeF1jd3BNolTylsoZGFQvpYkliFtHTL_AgaQh3gID9Z3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent product and engineering workflows.
- Issue tracking, sprints, roadmaps and prioritisation.
- Clean, fast interface.
- Less suited to managing every business function.

Best for: SaaS, software and AI startups.

[Visit Linear](https://linear.app/)

---

![Finastra Customer Story | ClickUp™](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/OXxUksa73j7hoTxbYQ6zo3pspX36GflPBLMsRWXjhfWZTJdFq6md_tXaxCCc_3Kjh0xQSrUSgXoCYi3d5TOe48r-mvzFwLplQbgf4lhsH3q_bsATt_hAcyva5qI1DtZG8OasgRxxldReZAIfURcJdNdt2Br8nPVvqn-lCO5aR2MxpFl9QAiCxibf4gzehOOb?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. ClickUp**

(Best all-rounder)

- Tasks, projects, documents and goals.
- Dashboards and automation.
- Highly customisable.
- Can become overwhelming if over-configured.

Best for: Startups wanting one system for the whole business.

[Visit ClickUp](https://clickup.com/)

---

![Projects & Tasks Template by Notion | Notion Marketplace](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/yqXS2tBYYgklcz7vMhTTs4bLbvL88Cgi4WoUElrVJ5Ge7XTkOSgH-nuQji_OGnf8zWep9eOojCOQh5DYOROLY-F6UHVJa4vD9y9Gw17JhHC7tidutG-zxz3QXJjQVsnaYpKpPYmxZIPnjIweR9b7UOV1D2uLBf_LEDZlwhs7mXltRyaeNFILrJPVDr6f7980?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

- Combines project tracking, documentation and knowledge management.
- Great for company wikis and meeting notes.
- Flexible databases and templates.
- Requires some setup to create a good workflow.

Best for: Early-stage startups building processes from scratch.

[Visit Notion](https://www.notion.com/)

---

![Show tasks and milestones per project in Portfolio Timeline - Product Feedback - Asana Forum](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/WdbzrV3coAvJm-GewoC9GUVfJkq8C2TMbblEQvOx15prYXK1dOVkjrDVYAgw0KBZMGXFs9retNvetWxcuET-bGnlQaiBAT7rSMwCTcYBnWLu2-nxTqvSwhmbG6_UmXEy4KOaoWdxi7bX62AlUNzYyu7wGMyODlO-fsAyrwEwsCY7wGGgmlfx660ByC5Pht0D?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**

- Excellent task ownership and accountability.
- Project timelines and dependencies.
- Good cross-department visibility.
- More structured than some early-stage teams need.

Best for: Teams coordinating sales, marketing, operations and product.

[Visit Asana](https://asana.com/)

---

![Temas de visualización en monday.com (modo claro, oscuro y noche) – Support](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uyC8YNrkiQrDa1Sb5MqXshVpUb4T4J0lEilp2OCF3E30yLN-W5LsVxJNQnlcNOr03He3I-nA7i6TOOQk9RnUQPoqrGzAr6wbFHF2nVIldYywV3MdpytQ6lMrgikBBa--UZ1PrURUmR5LQVCX3NI_qh_0h_vL_1lqWVin-VHFDi8IADJDi_mPjNten_Unf3ik?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. monday.com**

- Visual project dashboards.
- Custom workflows and automations.
- Good for operational processes.
- Can become expensive as the team grows.

Best for: Non-technical and operations-heavy startups.

[Visit monday.com](https://monday.com/)

These choices reflect the different strengths identified in 2026 comparisons of startup project management software. ## My recommended startup setup

I would avoid buying five different tools at the beginning.

A simple combination works well\:

| Function | Tool |
|--------|--------|
| Project management | Linear or ClickUp |
| Company documentation | Notion |
| Team communication | Slack |
| Customer management | HubSpot |
| Product design | Figma |


For an early-stage startup, start with as few tools as possible and add complexity only when you need it.

## Which one should you choose?

My recommendation\:

- **Pre-seed / 1–5 people\:** Notion or Trello.
- **Seed stage / 5–15 people\:** ClickUp.
- **Tech startup / software development\:** Linear.
- **Growing startup / 15–50 people\:** ClickUp or Asana.
- **Operations-heavy startup\:** monday.com.
